text: TSA officers resume receiving pay following executive-directed funding action. DHS remains partially unfunded with legislative negotiations ongoing. Airport operations stabilize at the screening layer while agency-wide funding gap persists.

meta.note: Operational continuity restored at sub-agency level without resolving full funding structure.

text: Single-vehicle rollover crash leads to DUI arrests following roadside evaluation indicating impairment. No injuries or additional individuals are involved. Detention occurs with release contingent on bond. Competitive participation status remains undetermined.

meta.note: Impairment determination occurs despite zero BAC, introducing classification complexity.
